profile_help: JSON: one topic per device with "fields" and "timestamp" (see documentation). MTECmqtt: reads the Energy Butler from the MQTT output of MTECmqtt; the heat pump can still be read via JSON.
MQTT_TOPIC in the MTECmqtt configuration: MQTT_TOPIC in the MTECmqtt configuration, default MTEC
Serial number of the Energy Butler: Serial number of the Energy Butler
Empty = use the first one seen. With sev: Empty = use the first one seen. With several devices: one instance per device.
staleSeconds_help: If the last measurement is older, info.stale of the device is set to true. MTECmqtt sends about every 10 to 15 s.
Slow MTECmqtt groups count as outdated a: Slow MTECmqtt groups count as outdated after (seconds)
staleSecondsSlow_help: MTECmqtt sends phase and PV string values only about every 50 s. Without new values for this long, they are set to null.
Grid import price in cents per kWh (e.g. 26)
priceImportCt_help: Energy price without base fee, in cents. 0 = not set, then no cost is calculated.
Feed-in tariff in cents per kWh (e.g. 8.1)
currency_help: Symbol for amounts, e.g. €, CHF, $. Enter prices in cents (1/100 of the currency) anyway.
